# Load-test results (generated by load-tests/summarize.mjs)

Median run of three per configuration; latencies in ms, measured by k6 inside the Compose network.
Throughput = recorded requests / measured duration (setup logins and warm-up excluded).

## Idle baseline (no load)

| server | transactions/s | rows returned/s |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| primary | 6.5 | 761 |
| replica | 0.6 | 8 |

### Database work per server during the median runs

`pg_stat_database` deltas of database `nestdb` (includes k6 setup: 20 logins and ~80 fixture reads, and background relay/exporter activity).

| arm | server | transactions | tx/s | rows returned (scanned) | rows fetched | share of transactions | share of rows scanned |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| replica | primary | 514 | 7.2 | 60,416 | 11,728 | 1.02 % | 0.00 % |
| replica | replica | 50026 | 697.4 | 3,046,802,387 | 104,623 | 98.98 % | 100.00 % |
| single | primary | 68780 | 1030.4 | 4,154,197,656 | 145,359 | 99.94 % | 100.00 % |
| single | replica | 41 | 0.6 | 573 | 546 | 0.06 % | 0.00 % |

**Headline A:** with the replica, the standby served 98.98 % of the read transactions of the history workload; throughput 457.5 vs 625.9 req/s (-26.9 %), p95 80.2 vs 68.3 ms.
